headline: China sentences ministry official to de@th for leaking over one hundred state secrets
label: NEWS
caption:
A Chinese ministry official has been sentenced to de@th in a major foreign espionage case 🇨🇳

China has sentenced a ministry official to de@th for spying and leaking national secrets, according to reports from Reuters and AP News.

The official reportedly passed over one hundred state secrets to an unidentified foreign power, according to South China Morning Post.

Media outlet Firstpost reported claims that the official may have been honeytrapped before leaking the classified secrets.
